errors.evidence: The description states the period is from 2000 to 2055, but the data points on the chart are actually present from approximately 2011 to 2050.

errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена с проценти
errors.evidence: The Y-axis does not have a label. The unit 'percent' is derived from the legend's description of the data series, not from an explicit axis label.
The description claims there is only one line, but the chart and its legend clearly show two distinct lines: a solid line with markers and a dotted trendline.

errors.text_span: В началото, около годината 2000, линията започва от стойност около 14%.
errors.evidence: The data does not start in the year 2000. The first data point is around 2011, and its value is approximately 7%, not 14%.

errors.text_span: До около 2010 година линията се понижава до стойност около 6%.
errors.evidence: The chart contains no data prior to 2011 and does not show any decrease to 6%. This part of the description describes a trend that does not exist in the figure.

errors.text_span: Между 2010 и 2020 година, линията се покачва до стойност около 18%.
errors.evidence: Within the 2010-2020 interval, the data points show a rise to a maximum value of approximately 13%, not 18%.
The description incorrectly states the period ends in 2055; the final data point on the chart is at the year 2050.

The description dismisses the dotted line (logarithmic trendline), failing to describe its location and its function of tracing the data points from approximately 2011 to 2016. This is a significant omission of a visual element.
